pmsIntegration.heading: Seamless PMS Integration
pmsIntegration.description: PracticeDilly seamlessly integrates with leading PMS, CRM, and analytics platforms, giving you effortless visibility across your operations.
bullets: Every inbound and outbound call is linked to the correct patient profile in your PMS, giving your team instant context without manual lookups.
Initiate calls directly from your PMS while PracticeDilly captures transcriptions, call outcomes, and key insights in real time.
Keep communication, scheduling, and front-office operations fully aligned across locations without disrupting existing PMS processes.
PracticeDilly works alongside your PMS to ensure cleaner data, faster follow-ups, and a smoother experience for both team members and patients.

testimonial.quote: After 30 days on PracticeDilly, we identified 52 missed patient calls in our opportunity bucket. The AI organized each call with the patient's details, allowing us to follow up and schedule them. This resulted in converting all 52 opportunities, generating approximately $78,000 in additional revenue for the practice.
